{{Top|leg}}
'''Patrol command''' was a part of the defensive layers around the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fortress [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]]. It dispatched ships in support of the [[deep patrol]] [[Imperial Patrol Frigate|frigates]], such as the [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] ''[[Gorath]]'' under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Voba Dokrett]] and the [[Adz-class patrol destroyer|''Adz''-class patorl destroyer]] ''[[Tobay]]'', commanded by Captain [[Gegak]].
